text.text: Redesign your enterprise wireless LAN to support the rapid increase of mobile devices. Cisco has developed an enterprise access point that supports 802.11ac Wave 2, the latest Wi-Fi technology. Designed for small and medium-sized networks, the1850 Series delivers the performance you need for the ongoing proliferation of Wave 2 as well as support for older Wi-Fi devices
